recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless the FM work group reintroduces ProcessRequest or identifies an active FM resource that lacks the expected status element or status search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-5439 was a Published FHIR-core/FM ProcessRequest change request from the January 2015 ballot. It asked that status be a property of the underlying resource and a status search parameter, and the final Persuasive with Modification resolution said status had already been added to all FM resources for STU3.
initial_application: No FHIR-5439-keyed source commit was found. Git history shows StatusRequest was replaced by ProcessRequest in 2015, and e0b5e2fb33 in 2016 added status to EligibilityResponse, EnrollmentResponse, ProcessRequest, and ProcessResponse. The retained ProcessRequest spreadsheet includes ProcessRequest.status and a status search parameter.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini comments ProcessRequest and ProcessResponse out of the active resources/workgroups, lists ProcessRequest among removed resources, and notes ProcessRequest should use Task. FHIR-5440 is the same-change-family ProcessResponse counterpart and is already audited on the combined branch. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing the retired ProcessRequest source or adding redundant prose would not alter the current FHIR build, and all active FM resources already satisfy the Jira resolution.
